description: Template for the simple NNUE runner. Copy and edit before launch.
hypothesis: State exactly why this run should improve the current native reference.

stages.name: train
stages.why: Train only the variables listed in changed_variables.

stages.name: static_gate
stages.why: Reject if held-out metrics do not improve without broad drift.

stages.name: sprt_if_candidate
stages.why: Launch only when static_gate marks the net candidate-worthy.

gates: train/export command must produce one model.nn
static gate must report changed-variable metrics and decision
SPRT is allowed only for candidate_for_sprt_review
